items.source: Create a new MergedContextConfiguration instance for the supplied parameters.
items.translation: 为提供的参数创建一个新的MergedContextConfiguration实例。

items.source: contextLoader - the resolved ContextLoader
items.translation: contextLoader - 解析后的 ContextLoader

items.source: testClass - the test class for which the configuration was merged
items.translation: testClass - 已合并配置对应的测试类

items.source: locations - the merged context resource locations
items.translation: locations - 合并后的上下文资源位置

items.source: classes - the merged annotated classes
items.translation: classes - 合并后的已注解类

items.source: activeProfiles - the merged active bean definition profiles
items.translation: activeProfiles - 合并后的活动 Bean 定义配置文件

items.source: since 6.1 in favor of MergedContextConfiguration(Class, String[], Class[], Set, String[], List, String[], Set, ContextLoader, CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate, MergedContextConfiguration)
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，推荐使用 MergedContextConfiguration(Class, String[], Class[], Set, String[], List, String[], Set, ContextLoader, CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate, MergedContextConfiguration)

items.source: contextInitializerClasses - the merged context initializer classes
items.translation: contextInitializerClasses - 合并后的上下文初始化类

items.source: cacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate - a cache-aware context loader delegate with which to retrieve the parent ApplicationContext
items.translation: cacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate - 一个用于获取父级 ApplicationContext 的缓存感知上下文加载器委托。

items.source: parent - the parent configuration or null if there is no parent
items.translation: parent - 父配置或如果没有父配置则为 null

items.source: Properties will be loaded into the Environment's set of PropertySources.
items.translation: 属性将被加载到 Environment 的 PropertySources 集合中。

items.source: Determine if the supplied object is equal to this MergedContextConfiguration instance by comparing both objects' locations, annotated classes, context initializer classes, active profiles, property source descriptors, property source properties, context customizers, parents, and the fully qualified names of their ContextLoaders.
items.translation: 通过比较两个对象的 locations、annotated classes、context initializer classes、active profiles、property source descriptors、property source properties、context customizers、parents 以及它们的 ContextLoaders 的完全限定名，来确定提供的对象是否等于此 MergedContextConfiguration 实例。

items.source: Provide a String representation of the test class, locations, annotated classes, context initializer classes, active profiles, property source descriptors, property source properties, context customizers, the name of the ContextLoader, and the parent configuration.
items.translation: 提供 `测试类`、`位置`、`注解类`、`上下文初始化类`、`活动配置文件`、`属性源描述符`、`属性源属性`、`上下文定制器` 的字符串表示形式，`ContextLoader` 的名称以及 `父配置`。

items.source: Generate a null-safe String representation of the supplied ContextLoader based solely on the fully qualified name of the loader or "null" if the supplied loader is null.
items.translation: 生成一个针对所提供的基于完全限定名的加载器或如果提供的加载器为null则为"null"的 null-safeString表示形式的 ContextLoader。

items.source: Get the resolved ContextLoader for the test class.
items.translation: 获取测试类的已解析ContextLoader。

items.source: since 6.1 in favor of getPropertySourceDescriptors()
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，推荐使用getPropertySourceDescriptors()。

items.source: Get the merged ContextCustomizers that will be applied when the application context is loaded.
items.translation: 获取将在加载应用程序上下文时应用的合并的ContextCustomizers。

items.source: Get the merged ApplicationContextInitializer classes for the test class.
items.translation: 获取测试类的合并ApplicationContextInitializer类。

items.source: Get the MergedContextConfiguration for the parent application context in a context hierarchy.
items.translation: 在上下文层次结构中获取父应用程序上下文的MergedContextConfiguration。

items.source: Generate a unique hash code for all properties of this MergedContextConfiguration excluding the test class.
items.translation: 为此 `MergedContextConfiguration` 的所有属性生成一个唯一的哈希码，但排除 测试类。

items.source: Get the merged active bean definition profiles for the test class.
items.translation: 获取测试类 test class 的合并活动 Bean 定义配置文件。

items.source: Get the merged annotated classes for the test class.
items.translation: 获取测试类的合并注释类。

items.source: propertySourceLocations - the merged PropertySource locations
items.translation: propertySourceLocations - 合并后的 PropertySource 位置

items.source: propertySourceProperties - the merged PropertySource properties
items.translation: propertySourceProperties - 合并后的 PropertySource 属性

items.source: contextCustomizers - the context customizers
items.translation: contextCustomizers - 上下文自定义器

items.source: If a null value is supplied for locations, classes, activeProfiles, propertySourceLocations, or propertySourceProperties an empty array will be stored instead. If a null value is supplied for contextInitializerClasses or contextCustomizers, an empty set will be stored instead. Furthermore, active profiles will be sorted, and duplicate profiles will be removed.
items.translation: 如果为 `locations`、`classes`、`activeProfiles`、`propertySourceLocations` 或 `propertySourceProperties` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空数组。如果为 `contextInitializerClasses` 或 `contextCustomizers` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空集。此外，活动配置文件将被排序，并移除重复的配置文件。

items.source: Merged context resource locations, annotated classes, active profiles, property resource locations, and in-lined properties represent all declared values in the test class hierarchy and enclosing class hierarchy taking into consideration the semantics of the ContextConfiguration.inheritLocations(), ActiveProfiles.inheritProfiles(), TestPropertySource.inheritLocations(), and TestPropertySource.inheritProperties() flags.
items.translation: 合并的上下文资源位置、注解类、激活的配置文件、属性资源位置以及内联属性代表了测试类层次结构和包围类层次结构中声明的所有值，同时考虑了 `ContextConfiguration.inheritLocations()`、`ActiveProfiles.inheritProfiles()`、`TestPropertySource.inheritLocations()` 和 `TestPropertySource.inheritProperties()` 标志的语义。

items.source: If a null value is supplied for locations, classes, activeProfiles, propertySourceLocations, or propertySourceProperties an empty array will be stored instead. If a null value is supplied for the contextInitializerClasses an empty set will be stored instead. Furthermore, active profiles will be sorted, and duplicate profiles will be removed.
items.translation: 如果为 `locations`、`classes`、`activeProfiles`、`propertySourceLocations` 或 `propertySourceProperties` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空数组。如果为 `contextInitializerClasses` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空集。此外，活动配置文件将被排序，并移除重复的配置文件。

items.source: If a null value is supplied for locations, classes, activeProfiles, or propertySourceProperties an empty array will be stored instead. If a null value is supplied for contextInitializerClasses or contextCustomizers, an empty set will be stored instead. Furthermore, active profiles will be sorted, and duplicate profiles will be removed.
items.translation: 如果为 `locations`、`classes`、`activeProfiles` 或 `propertySourceProperties` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空数组。如果为 `contextInitializerClasses` 或 `contextCustomizers` 提供 `null` 值，将存储一个空集。此外，活动配置文件将被排序，并移除重复的配置文件。

items.source: MergedContextConfiguration is also used by the ContextCache as the key for caching an ApplicationContext that was loaded using properties of this MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: `MergedContextConfiguration` 也被 `ContextCache` 用作缓存键，用于缓存使用此 `MergedContextConfiguration` 的属性加载的 `ApplicationContext`。

items.source: A SmartContextLoader uses MergedContextConfiguration to load an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: `SmartContextLoader` 使用 `MergedContextConfiguration` 来加载一个 `ApplicationContext`。

items.source:
Context resource locations typically represent XML configuration
files or Groovy scripts.
items.translation: 上下文资源位置通常代表 XML 配置文件或 Groovy 脚本。

items.source:
If the parent context has not yet been loaded, it will be loaded, stored
in the cache, and then returned.
items.translation: 如果父上下文尚未加载，它将先被加载并存储到缓存中，然后返回。

items.source: Get the parent ApplicationContext for the context defined by this MergedContextConfiguration from the context cache.
items.translation: 从上下文缓存中获取由此 `MergedContextConfiguration` 定义的上下文的父 ApplicationContext。

items.source: Create a new MergedContextConfiguration instance by copying all fields from the supplied MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 通过复制提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 的所有字段来创建一个新的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 实例。

items.source: Get the merged resource locations for ApplicationContext configuration files for the test class.
items.translation: 获取测试类的测试类的ApplicationContext配置文件的合并资源位置。

items.source: Get the merged descriptors for resource locations for test PropertySources for the test class.
items.translation: 获取测试类 `<a href="#getTestClass()">` 的 `PropertySources` 测试的资源位置的合并描述符。

items.source: Get the test class associated with this MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 获取与此`MergedContextConfiguration`关联的测试类。

items.source: Get the merged inlined properties for the test class.
items.translation: 获取测试类的合并内联属性。

items.source: Determine if this MergedContextConfiguration instance has class-based resources.
items.translation: 确定此 `MergedContextConfiguration` 实例是否具有基于类的资源。

items.source: Determine if this MergedContextConfiguration instance has path-based context resource locations.
items.translation: 确定此 `MergedContextConfiguration` 实例是否具有基于路径的上下文资源位置。

items.source: Determine if this MergedContextConfiguration instance has either path-based context resource locations or class-based resources.
items.translation: 确定此MergedContextConfiguration实例是否具有基于路径的上下文资源位置或基于类的资源。

items.source: Get the merged resource locations of properties files for the test class.
items.translation: 获取测试类 test class 的属性文件的合并资源位置。
